_doc: Pinned sources for the ranking and scoring slices built by workspace/build_rank_score_cases.py. Revisions checked on Hugging Face on 2026-10-11.

scifact.exposure: public BEIR benchmark; possible training exposure
scifact.notes: Queries are scientific claims; relevant abstracts support or refute them. Test qrels are binary (grade 1).

nfcorpus.exposure: public BEIR benchmark; possible training exposure
nfcorpus.notes: Lay health questions against PubMed abstracts. Test qrels are graded 1 (partially) and 2 (highly); unjudged documents count as 0.

helpsteer2.exposure: public reward-model training data; likely training exposure
helpsteer2.notes: Human ratings 0-4 per response. The validation split is used; helpfulness is the attribute scored.

rewardbench2.notes: Best-of-4: one correct response, three rejected. The Ties subset allows several correct answers and is excluded.
